title: [CQ-V12a] Delivery bypass acceptance fixtures
description:
Objective: daemon-side, end-to-end proof that forged, stale, missing, target-raced or crash-replayed evidence cannot pass the CQ-V gates. This is V12's DoD 1, split out of the epic-final V12 (task-b621ddc9) on 2026-10-29 by architect-e4b7eee0 for size. V12 keeps the docs sweep, the whole-epic review and regression, and re-runs these fixtures unchanged.

Deliverable:
- A new packages/moe-daemon/src/__acceptance__/deliveryBypass.acceptance.test.ts built on CQ-V11's harness (src/__acceptance__/mcpCall.ts: createMcpCaller, McpCallError, the gatedApproval scenario of producerConsumer.acceptance.test.ts). Every call goes through McpAdapter, never an imported handler.
- The two CQ-V01 QA hand-forward tests in src/delivery/requiredChecks.delivery.test.ts. They are spelled out in V12's comment from qa-7c627d35 (2026-10-26).

Fixture classes, all on a STRICT task:
- A verified-local task is built the way CQ-V06's reviewBinding.test.ts and src/__e2e__/executionContract.e2e.test.ts drive one. The readiness gate (assertExecutionProfileReady) is spied ONLY inside the test; the precedent is src/server/planApproval.test.ts:1095. Production readiness stays unconditionally unavailable.
- Forgery: a /mcp record_check_run claiming runner-observed; record_check_dispatch or record_check_observation without the /runner context; observation args carrying runnerId, source, candidateId, treeSha or planRevision.
- Stale: a passing run on a superseded candidate, an older plan revision, or a stale served-context receipt.
- Missing check: missing, skipped, inconclusive, timeout and infra-failure results, and an exit-0 run followed by a tree, index or HEAD mutation (CQ-V04).
- Target race and receipt crash, daemon side: a receipt or landing record for a tree other than the verified candidate's; an identical receipt replayed after a fresh StateManager load over the same .moe directory.
- At least one case runs over the real /runner WebSocket with a host key in a temp MOE_RUNNER_KEY_DIR (CQ-V03a). A wrong or missing key is refused at upgrade.

Assumed interfaces, from approved plans; adapt to the LANDED names:
- V03a: server/runnerChannel.ts (RUNNER_KEY_HEADER, ensureRunnerKey, authenticateRunner), ToolCallContext.runner.
- V03b: state/checkObservationStore.ts (recordCheckDispatch, recordCheckObservation, isAuthenticatedCheckRun).
- V03 tools: moe.record_check_dispatch and moe.record_check_observation.
- V04's dispatch flow, which is unplanned at the time of writing.
- V06: delivery/reviewBinding.ts (assertReviewedCandidateCurrent), and qa_approve's attemptId, generation, sessionId and candidateId.
- V05b's repair transitions.
- moe.record_delivery_receipt and moe.finalize_attempt.

Error handling: assert exact codeNames and tokens, never truthiness. A bypass a fixture exposes is fixed at its source module, with that fixture as the regression, never by weakening the fixture.

Scope boundaries: no new production surface beyond such fixes; no client UI; no wrapper changes (CQ-V08b owns those); no .moe edits; verified-local stays unavailable outside test spies.

Verification command (fresh, exit 0 required): cd packages/moe-daemon && npm test
definitionOfDone: Forgery: a /mcp record_check_run claiming runner-observed, a dispatch or observation sent without the /runner context, and observation args carrying runnerId/source/candidateId each leave a strict task's qa_approve refused, with exact codeNames and tokens asserted, proven by src/__acceptance__/deliveryBypass.acceptance.test.ts.
Stale: a passing run on a superseded candidate, on an older plan revision, or under a stale served-context receipt cannot satisfy qa_approve, with each exact codeName asserted in the same file.

Missing check: missing, skipped, inconclusive, timeout and infra-failure required checks, and an exit-0 run followed by a tree/index/HEAD mutation, each keep qa_approve refused, proven in the same file.

Target race and receipt crash, daemon side: a receipt for a tree other than the verified candidate's never satisfies delivery evidence or a strict consumer's dependency, and an identical receipt replayed after a fresh StateManager load is idempotent with dependents unchanged, proven in the same file.
At least one case runs over the real /runner WebSocket with a host key (a wrong or missing key is refused at upgrade); every other case goes only through createMcpCaller.

The two CQ-V01 hand-forward tests in requiredChecks.delivery.test.ts (a corrupt requiredChecks entry gives protected-checks-unapproved; a duplicate candidate protected path, first or last, gives protected-checks-unmeasured) each kill their named mutant on a scratch copy.
Fresh verification `cd packages/moe-daemon && npm test` exits 0 and its output is supplied to complete_task.
taskRails: No direct .moe edits; no Git-write commands by agents; wrappers own landing.
Do not enable verified-local or claim isolation until all requisite implementation and certification gates pass.
